Removing the deferred-fiber registration (src/index.ts:756-766, :796-812) reintroduces the observed bundle-startup route/provider loss.
Treating 'stalled' as terminal breaks stalled->running recovery (src/tasks.ts:283-286, probe/verify-subagent-run-ledger.mjs:93-97).
Rewriting open() to jump straight to CDP loses the killFirst preflight passthrough (src/sessions.ts:369-371) that makes kill_first reachable at all.
